def collect_parameters(uri_query='', body=None, headers=None,
    exclude_oauth_signature=True, with_realm=False):
    collected = []
    
    # Handle case-insensitive Authorization header
    if headers:
        auth_header = None
        for key, value in headers.items():
            if key.lower() == 'authorization':
                auth_header = value
                break
        
        if auth_header and auth_header.startswith('OAuth '):
            auth_params = utils.parse_authorization_header(auth_header)
            collected.extend(auth_params)
    
    # Parse parameters from URI query
    if uri_query:
        collected.extend(urlparse.parse_qsl(uri_query, keep_blank_values=True))
    
    # Parse parameters from request body
    if body:
        collected.extend(urlparse.parse_qsl(body, keep_blank_values=True))
    
    # Filter out realm if requested
    if not with_realm:
        collected = [(k, v) for k, v in collected if k != 'realm']
    
    # Filter out oauth_signature if requested
    if exclude_oauth_signature:
        collected = [(k, v) for k, v in collected if k != 'oauth_signature']
    
    return collected
